name: Cotton Leaf Curl
remedy: Control whiteflies, remove affected growth, and use certified resistant cotton varieties.

name: Cotton Bacterial Blight
remedy: Use certified disease-free seed, remove infected debris, and avoid overhead irrigation.

name: Cotton Root Rot
remedy: Remove severely affected plants, improve soil drainage, and avoid planting cotton in infested soil.

name: Cotton Alternaria Leaf Spot
remedy: Remove infected leaves, maintain balanced crop nutrition, and apply a recommended fungicide.

name: Cotton Fusarium Wilt
remedy: Use resistant varieties, remove infected plants, and practice crop rotation.

name: Early Blight
remedy: Apply a recommended fungicide, remove affected leaves, and improve airflow between plants.

name: Late Blight
remedy: Remove infected plant material, avoid wet foliage, and apply an appropriate fungicide promptly.

name: Tomato Leaf Curl
remedy: Control whiteflies, remove affected plants, and use resistant tomato varieties.

name: Tomato Powdery Mildew
remedy: Improve airflow, remove affected leaves, and apply a suitable powdery mildew treatment.

name: Tomato Root Rot
remedy: Improve drainage, reduce excess watering, and remove severely affected plants.

name: Late Blight
remedy: Apply an appropriate fungicide immediately and remove infected plants.

name: Potato Early Blight
remedy: Remove affected leaves, rotate crops, and apply a potato-safe fungicide according to its label.

name: Potato Blackleg
remedy: Remove infected plants and tubers, improve drainage, and plant certified disease-free seed.

name: Potato Common Scab
remedy: Maintain consistent soil moisture and use certified seed potatoes from healthy stock.

name: Potato Virus Disease
remedy: Control aphids, remove infected plants, and use certified virus-free seed potatoes.

name: Powdery Mildew
remedy: Remove heavily affected leaves and apply a suitable mildew treatment.

name: Cucumber Downy Mildew
remedy: Improve airflow, avoid overhead watering, and apply a recommended downy mildew treatment.

name: Cucumber Angular Leaf Spot
remedy: Use disease-free seed, avoid working with wet plants, and remove infected leaves.

name: Cucumber Anthracnose
remedy: Remove infected plant material, improve airflow, and apply a recommended fungicide.

name: Cucumber Mosaic Virus
remedy: Control aphids, remove infected plants, and disinfect tools between plants.
